title: Graduate Electrical Engineer
summary: Support distribution projects, site inspections and technical reporting at an electricity services company in Harare.
description_md:
Example Power Services is recruiting a **Graduate Electrical Engineer** to assist engineers on distribution network projects.

### Responsibilities
- Assist with site inspections and commissioning checks
- Prepare technical reports and as-built drawings
- Support the safety and quality programme
requirements_md:
- Bachelor's degree in electrical or electronic engineering
- Basic technical reporting skills
- Willingness to work on site
location_text: Head office, with regular site travel

professional_registration: Registration with the relevant statutory professional body, or eligibility to register
